prs.author: Genmin

members.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs make the identical regex change to buildWellKnownPath, so they'd conflict if merged together. #2214 additionally applies the same fix to buildDiscoveryUrls's own local trailing-slash-stripping code (a second, independent copy of the same bug), while #2215 leaves that second copy on the old single-slash strip logic. #2215's only other change is to shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check ('/' -> ''), which is an unrelated bug (redundant fallback attempt on an already-root path) rather than part of this trailing-slash duplicate, so it doesn't offset the incomplete coverage in buildDiscoveryUrls.
